newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends fragile in well-offered market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends fragile in well-offered market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was in a fragile condition on Wednesday with several small cargoes on offer in a fairly well-covered market, traders said.
At least five 10-12,000 tonne cargoes were reported to be on offer, but traders said demand was fairly lacklustre.
A German end-user was reported to have bought 5,000 tonnes at $184.50 cif NWE on Tuesday, and was offering a cargo at $188 on Wednesday.
While a trading house was reported to be bidding at $190 for 20-25,000 tonnes for pipeline, naphtha players said such quantities were not available rendering the bid somewhat unrealistic.
Swaps, meanwhile, were fairly steady with April quoted at $188.50/$189.50 and May at $189/$190.
"The pipeline bid is helping quotes, but the material doesn't really exist," said one trader.
